source_text: Post vitulum aureum sacrificia multiplicata — medicina superbiae. Lex paedagogus ad Christum.
pass_a_gloss: After calf golden sacrifices multiplied — medicine of-pride. Law pedagogue unto Christ.
pass_b_english: After the [[golden calf >> Bible:Exodus 32:4]] sacrifices multiplied — medicine for pride. The law is a [[pedagogue unto Christ >> Bible:Galatians 3:24]].
